Name: DGR 109 - VISCOUNT
Information:
**DGR 109 - VISCOUNT**

The VISCOUNT is functionally a bulky suit of mechanized armor, similar to the SVALINN or KAIKAVUS. It was designed for elite framebilt soldiers, bodyguards, and private combatants to use as an offensive weapon.

Information Sections.Title: DGR 109 - VISCOUNT
Information Sections.Text: The VISCOUNT is functionally a bulky suit of mechanized armor, similar to the SVALINN or KAIKAVUS. It was designed for elite framebilt soldiers, bodyguards, and private combatants to use as an offensive weapon.

traits.name: Solid Plating
traits.description: All damage that the DGR takes is reduced by 5 points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes two Eidopyre Chain attacks, one of which it can exchange with a use of its Micromissile Darts.

actions.name: Eidopyre Chain
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d8) fire damage.

If either of the d8 damage dice from this attack roll their maximum result and its target is Large or smaller, the chain wraps around the target, who is restrained and grappled (escape DC 14). While restrained this way they take a d8 of fire damage at the start of their turn. This effect ends if the DGR or the target move further away than this attack’s range, and while they are restrained this way the DGR loses one use of its Eidopyre Chain attack each turn unless it’s used to attack that target.

actions.name: Micromissile Darts
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) fire damage.
